timing_source: Actual recording WordBoundary; punctuation tokens have no fabricated cue

audio/en/accessible-game-0.mp3.text: The game needs a high reach. Zaid prefers to play sitting down.

audio/en/accessible-game-1.mp3.text: One partner says: We want a fun game. The other says: I want to join from a comfortable position.

audio/en/accessible-game-2.mp3.text: Could we change the materials instead of leaving a player out?

audio/en/accessible-game-5.mp3.text: Try joining large pieces from comfortable positions.

audio/en/accessible-game-6.mp3.text: Can everyone take a real part rather than a token role?

audio/en/accessible-game-solution-0.mp3.text: Place the target within reach. Each player chooses a comfortable position.

audio/en/accessible-game-solution-1.mp3.text: Turn the idea into a table game everyone can reach.

audio/en/accidental-topple-0.mp3.text: Sami accidentally touched the tower and it fell. Layan needs space and help.

audio/en/accidental-topple-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to help repair it. The other says: I need space before rebuilding.

audio/en/accidental-topple-2.mp3.text: I am sorry that happened. Would you like my help now?

audio/en/accidental-topple-5.mp3.text: Act this out with a small tower and clear permission.

audio/en/accidental-topple-6.mp3.text: Did the repair help? Hugs or immediate forgiveness are never required.

audio/en/accidental-topple-solution-0.mp.text: Wait until Layan agrees, then rebuild one part together.

audio/en/accidental-topple-solution-1.mp.text: Offer nearby pieces if she wants them, and give her space.

audio/en/agreement-review-0.mp3.text: The team agreed on jobs, but Zaid still waits most of the time.

audio/en/agreement-review-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to finish my work. The other says: I want a role that really happens.

audio/en/agreement-review-2.mp3.text: What actually happened after our agreement?

audio/en/agreement-review-5.mp3.text: Try the revised agreement in a short building round.

audio/en/agreement-review-6.mp3.text: What changed in the waiting time and chance to take part?

audio/en/agreement-review-solution-0.mp3.text: Make each task shorter and try swapping sooner.

audio/en/agreement-review-solution-1.mp3.text: Choose useful tasks that everyone can do at the same time.

audio/en/animal-home-0.mp3.text: Hana wants a quiet rabbit home. Omar adds a large dinosaur.

audio/en/animal-home-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want space for the rabbit. The other says: I want room for the dinosaur.

audio/en/animal-home-2.mp3.text: How could we make room for both animals?

audio/en/animal-home-5.mp3.text: Move both toys and test the entrances and space.

audio/en/animal-home-6.mp3.text: Is there room for both toys without knocking down your partner's work?

audio/en/animal-home-solution-0.mp3.text: Build two neighbouring homes with a path between them.

audio/en/animal-home-solution-1.mp3.text: Make a shared yard and a separate corner for each toy.

audio/en/ball-pass-0.mp3.text: Layan wants to roll the ball. Sami wants to hold it a little longer.

audio/en/ball-pass-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to roll the ball. The other says: I need time to get ready.

audio/en/ball-pass-2.mp3.text: I am ready. May I roll it to you?

audio/en/ball-pass-5.mp3.text: Try passing the ball along the floor in a clear space.

audio/en/ball-pass-6.mp3.text: Did the ball arrive gently? You can move closer together.

audio/en/ball-pass-solution-0.mp3.text: Ask whether your partner is ready, then roll the ball gently.

audio/en/ball-pass-solution-1.mp3.text: Roll the ball around a cushion, then send it to your partner.

audio/en/block-box-0.mp3.text: The block box is close to Sami. Layan cannot reach it comfortably.

audio/en/block-box-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want blocks I can reach. The other says: I want to keep building.

audio/en/block-box-2.mp3.text: Can we put the box between us?

audio/en/block-box-5.mp3.text: Build two towers and try reaching the pieces.

audio/en/block-box-6.mp3.text: Is reaching easier now? Move the materials again if needed.

audio/en/block-box-solution-0.mp3.text: Move the light box where both of you can reach it.

audio/en/block-box-solution-1.mp3.text: Put blocks on two trays and exchange pieces when needed.

audio/en/block-bridge-0.mp3.text: Omar wants a tall bridge. Hana wants it wide enough for the car.

audio/en/block-bridge-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want a tall bridge. The other says: I want my car to pass.

audio/en/block-bridge-2.mp3.text: Can we test the width before adding height?

audio/en/block-bridge-5.mp3.text: Roll a car under the bridge. Change one piece if needed.

audio/en/block-bridge-6.mp3.text: Did the bridge include both ideas? Describe what you changed.

audio/en/block-bridge-solution-0.mp3.text: Build a wide base, test the car, then make the bridge taller.

audio/en/block-bridge-solution-1.mp3.text: Build two small bridges and compare how steady they are and whether the car fits.

audio/en/book-choice-0.mp3.text: Layan chooses an animal book. Sami chooses a vehicle book.

audio/en/book-choice-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want animal pictures. The other says: I want vehicle pictures.

audio/en/book-choice-2.mp3.text: I like this book. Which one do you like?

audio/en/book-choice-5.mp3.text: Open both books and try your choice with your grown-up.

audio/en/book-choice-6.mp3.text: Did each of you find a picture you like? You can change the plan.

audio/en/book-choice-solution-0.mp3.text: Take turns looking at one page from each book.

audio/en/book-choice-solution-1.mp3.text: Choose an animal and a vehicle, then make up a journey for them.

audio/en/borrow-toy-0.mp3.text: Sami likes Layan's special puppet. Layan wants to keep it with her.

audio/en/borrow-toy-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to try the puppet. The other says: I want to keep my puppet.

audio/en/borrow-toy-2.mp3.text: May I borrow it? You can say no.

audio/en/borrow-toy-5.mp3.text: Use two toys to act out asking to borrow and respecting the answer.

audio/en/borrow-toy-6.mp3.text: Did we respect the boundary? Sharing does not mean making someone give in.

audio/en/borrow-toy-solution-0.mp3.text: Respect the no and choose another shared toy.

audio/en/borrow-toy-solution-1.mp3.text: Layan may show her puppet if she wants. It stays in her hands.

audio/en/chair-layout-0.mp3.text: Hana wants a seat where she can see pictures. Omar wants to sit near his friend.

audio/en/chair-layout-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I need to see the book. The other says: I want to sit near my friend.

audio/en/chair-layout-2.mp3.text: Can we move the cushions so everyone can see?

audio/en/chair-layout-5.mp3.text: Arrange toy seats, then check whether everyone can see the picture.

audio/en/chair-layout-6.mp3.text: Could everyone see the picture without excluding anyone?

audio/en/chair-layout-solution-0.mp3.text: Arrange the cushions in a half circle without blocking the book.

audio/en/chair-layout-solution-1.mp3.text: Bring the book closer to each partner after a page.

audio/en/change-rule-0.mp3.text: Omar wants the basket farther away. Hana wants a distance she can manage. Can they change the rule together?

audio/en/change-rule-1.mp3.text: Omar wants a challenge. Hana wants a comfortable way to join. Both needs matter.

audio/en/change-rule-2.mp3.text: Ask: Can we test the new distance together before deciding?

audio/en/change-rule-3.mp3.text: Try a short test round, or let each player choose a suitable distance. Explore both plans.

audio/en/change-rule-5.mp3.text: Try your chosen rule with a soft ball or act it out with toys. Then confirm that you tried it.

audio/en/change-rule-6.mp3.text: Did everyone get to join? Keep the rule or change one part and test again.

audio/en/change-rule-solution-0.mp3.text: Try the new distance in a short round. Afterwards, ask each partner whether the change suited them.

audio/en/change-rule-solution-1.mp3.text: Choose a suitable distance for each player. A fair game can include different distances. Ask whether the plan feels right to everyone.

audio/en/changing-partner-0.mp3.text: Hana wants to try another game. Omar wants to keep building with her.

audio/en/changing-partner-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to try another activity. The other says: I want to keep building.

audio/en/changing-partner-2.mp3.text: I want to change activities. How can we leave our work safely?

audio/en/changing-partner-5.mp3.text: Act out ending a shared activity with clear, respectful words.

audio/en/changing-partner-6.mp3.text: Did we respect the choice to stop and look after the work?

audio/en/changing-partner-solution-0.mp3.text: Put the building in a safe place, then each choose an activity.

audio/en/changing-partner-solution-1.mp3.text: Hana explains her part. Omar may continue without changing it.

audio/en/choose-song-0.mp3.text: Layan wants a lively rhythm. Sami prefers a quiet tune.

audio/en/choose-song-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want a lively rhythm. The other says: I want a quiet tune.

audio/en/choose-song-2.mp3.text: Can we find a rhythm that suits us both?

audio/en/choose-song-5.mp3.text: Try a short rhythm. Stop whenever either partner asks.

audio/en/choose-song-6.mp3.text: Was the sound comfortable for both of you? Playing quietly is an option too.

audio/en/choose-song-solution-0.mp3.text: Try a short part of each choice at a comfortable volume.

audio/en/choose-song-solution-1.mp3.text: Make a simple rhythm together with gentle claps.

audio/en/clay-tool-0.mp3.text: Sami is making play dough balls. Layan wants the same roller.

audio/en/clay-tool-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to roll my dough. The other says: I want to finish my shape.

audio/en/clay-tool-2.mp3.text: Can we roll one piece for each of us?

audio/en/clay-tool-5.mp3.text: Make two shapes and try the option you agreed on.

audio/en/clay-tool-6.mp3.text: Did you make two shapes you both like?

audio/en/clay-tool-solution-0.mp3.text: Roll one small piece, then pass the roller.

audio/en/clay-tool-solution-1.mp3.text: One uses the roller. The other may flatten dough with a palm if they choose.

audio/en/clean-up-plan-0.mp3.text: Omar wants to collect everything quickly. Hana wants to sort the materials.

audio/en/clean-up-plan-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want a clear floor. The other says: I want to find the tools later.

audio/en/clean-up-plan-2.mp3.text: What do we need first to make the space comfortable?

audio/en/clean-up-plan-5.mp3.text: Tidy a small corner, then try finding one tool.

audio/en/clean-up-plan-6.mp3.text: Is the walkway clear, and is the tool easy to find?

audio/en/clean-up-plan-solution-0.mp3.text: Collect materials in a safe basket, then sort them together.

audio/en/clean-up-plan-solution-1.mp3.text: One clears the walkway while the other sorts the table materials.

audio/en/common-break.mp3.text: Take a break. You do not have to keep playing now. Return when you are ready.

audio/en/common-compare.mp3.text: Compare both plans. Choose what suits you both, or ask for another idea and help. Agreement is a choice.

audio/en/common-help.mp3.text: Say what you need and ask a grown-up for help. Agreement is a choice. Every partner may say no.

audio/en/common-intro.mp3.text: Listen to each partner and compare two plans. Try your agreement, then review it. You may stop or ask for help.

audio/en/common-saved.mp3.text: We saved an agreement we tried. We can return to it and change it when our needs change.

audio/en/common-teacher.mp3.text: I am your teacher. We will watch situations and listen to ideas. This is a demonstration. Afterwards, choose a situation and try it yourself.

audio/en/common-transition.mp3.text: Let us look at a new situation. Think about each partner’s needs without forcing a solution.

audio/en/conflicting-promises-0.mp3.text: Adam promised to build with Reem and tell a story with Zaid at the same time.

audio/en/conflicting-promises-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I am waiting for our plan. The other says: I need to explain what is possible.

audio/en/conflicting-promises-2.mp3.text: I made two plans for the same time. Can we plan again?

audio/en/conflicting-promises-5.mp3.text: Act out the two promises with puppets and a plan you can actually carry out.

audio/en/conflicting-promises-6.mp3.text: Is the plan clear now, or did we make another unclear promise?

audio/en/conflicting-promises-solution-0.text: Agree on a possible order for the activities. Either partner may decline.

audio/en/conflicting-promises-solution-1.text: If everyone agrees, make the building the setting for the story.

audio/en/costume-choice-0.mp3.text: Layan wants the scarf for a captain role. Sami chose it for his journey.

audio/en/costume-choice-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want a costume for my role. The other says: I want to finish my journey.

audio/en/costume-choice-2.mp3.text: Can we find something for each role?

audio/en/costume-choice-5.mp3.text: Act out two short scenes with safe costume pieces.

audio/en/costume-choice-6.mp3.text: Did each of you keep a role you enjoy?

audio/en/costume-choice-solution-0.mp3.text: Make a paper badge for one role and leave the scarf for the other.

audio/en/costume-choice-solution-1.mp3.text: Swap the scarf after a short scene you agree on.

audio/en/ending-play-0.mp3.text: It is time to move on. Adam wants to finish the bridge. Reem and Zaid are getting ready.

audio/en/ending-play-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to keep what I started. The other says: I need to get ready to move on.

audio/en/ending-play-2.mp3.text: What small step could help us keep our plan now?

audio/en/ending-play-5.mp3.text: Practise a short transition while keeping a part or a plan.

audio/en/ending-play-6.mp3.text: Do we know what to return to? Do not promise a time that cannot happen.

audio/en/ending-play-solution-0.mp3.text: Put the important part on a tray and return the other materials.

audio/en/ending-play-solution-1.mp3.text: Draw what remains and agree on a possible return time with your grown-up.

audio/en/found-property-0.mp3.text: The team finds a toy under the table. They do not know who owns it.

audio/en/found-property-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to find the owner. The other says: I want to keep the toy safe.

audio/en/found-property-2.mp3.text: Who can help us return it?

audio/en/found-property-5.mp3.text: Practise returning a toy with a puppet and a lost-property box.

audio/en/found-property-6.mp3.text: Is the toy safe, with a clear way to return it?

audio/en/found-property-solution-0.mp3.text: Give the toy to your grown-up and explain where you found it.

audio/en/found-property-solution-1.mp3.text: With your grown-up's guidance, put it in the known lost-property place.

audio/en/group-rule-0.mp3.text: Reem suggests a ball rule. Adam and Zaid do not understand it yet.

audio/en/group-rule-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to start the game. The other says: I want to understand what to do.

audio/en/group-rule-2.mp3.text: Could we show the rule before we start?

audio/en/group-rule-5.mp3.text: Try a short round without scores. Stop to ask questions.

audio/en/group-rule-6.mp3.text: Could everyone explain their step? Change anything that is still unclear.

audio/en/group-rule-solution-0.mp3.text: Show one slow round. Each player explains what they will do.

audio/en/group-rule-solution-1.mp3.text: Draw simple picture steps, then try them together.

audio/en/help-without-taking-0.mp3.text: Hana wants to help Omar build. He wants to try it himself.

audio/en/help-without-taking-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to help. The other says: I want to try it myself.

audio/en/help-without-taking-2.mp3.text: Would you like a hint, or shall I wait beside you?

audio/en/help-without-taking-5.mp3.text: Try offering one kind of help after asking permission.

audio/en/help-without-taking-6.mp3.text: Did the person trying still get to do the work?

audio/en/help-without-taking-solution-0..text: If Omar asks, Hana describes where the piece goes. He places it himself.

audio/en/help-without-taking-solution-1..text: Hana waits without touching the work. Omar asks for help if he needs it.

audio/en/kit-tools-0.mp3.text: Hana needs the large tongs. Omar is using them to move pieces.

audio/en/kit-tools-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to move pieces. The other says: I need the tongs for building.

audio/en/kit-tools-2.mp3.text: How many pieces do you need before I use the tongs?

audio/en/kit-tools-5.mp3.text: Build a small part with large pieces and safe tongs.

audio/en/kit-tools-6.mp3.text: Did the tongs help both projects, or should the turn be shorter?

audio/en/kit-tools-solution-0.mp3.text: Agree on a small job, then pass the tongs.

audio/en/kit-tools-solution-1.mp3.text: One moves the pieces the other requests, then you swap jobs.

audio/en/new-idea-test-0.mp3.text: Zaid suggests a new passage. Reem and Adam want to keep the old route.

audio/en/new-idea-test-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to try my idea. The other says: I want to keep what already works.

audio/en/new-idea-test-2.mp3.text: Can we test the idea without dismantling the original?

audio/en/new-idea-test-5.mp3.text: Move the toy through both routes and describe what happened.

audio/en/new-idea-test-6.mp3.text: What evidence helps us keep the change or put the piece back?

audio/en/new-idea-test-solution-0.mp3.text: Build a small model beside the route, then compare how toys move through it.

audio/en/new-idea-test-solution-1.mp3.text: Agree to change one piece and keep a way to put it back.

audio/en/new-player-0.mp3.text: Adam and Reem are building a bridge. Zaid wants to join. Can they find a useful role without knocking down the work?

audio/en/new-player-1.mp3.text: Zaid wants to help build. Adam and Reem want to keep their bridge safe. Listen to both needs.

audio/en/new-player-2.mp3.text: Ask: What can I build with you? Show me which part needs help.

audio/en/new-player-3.mp3.text: Zaid could build the road or another part of the bridge. Ask what he would like to try.

audio/en/new-player-5.mp3.text: Build a small part together, then test the bridge with a toy car. Confirm only after you try.

audio/en/new-player-6.mp3.text: Did Zaid have a useful role? Did everyone agree? Change the jobs if needed.

audio/en/new-player-solution-0.mp3.text: Zaid chooses to build the road. Show where it meets the bridge and leave him a real building job. Ask whether it suits him.

audio/en/new-player-solution-1.mp3.text: Choose a part of the bridge that Zaid wants to build. Explain how it connects. Then the group tests the car together.

audio/en/noise-neighbours-0.mp3.text: The team makes a noisy toy route. Someone nearby is reading quietly.

audio/en/noise-neighbours-1.mp3.text: One partner says: We want to test the route. The other says: Someone else needs quiet.

audio/en/noise-neighbours-2.mp3.text: How can we play without making the space uncomfortable?

audio/en/noise-neighbours-5.mp3.text: Try one short test and ask whether the people nearby are comfortable.

audio/en/noise-neighbours-6.mp3.text: Did the sound change enough? If not, plan again.

audio/en/noise-neighbours-solution-0.mp3.text: Put the toy route on a mat that softens the sound.

audio/en/noise-neighbours-solution-1.mp3.text: Move the route to a safe space suited to this activity.

audio/en/one-refuses-0.mp3.text: The group suggests a touching game. Zaid does not want that kind of play.

audio/en/one-refuses-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want a group game. The other says: I do not want touching in the game.

audio/en/one-refuses-2.mp3.text: I do not want touching. Can we find another way?

audio/en/one-refuses-5.mp3.text: Try a no-touch signal game and respect anyone's choice to stop.

audio/en/one-refuses-6.mp3.text: Did the right to say no stay clear after the agreement?

audio/en/one-refuses-solution-0.mp3.text: Use a hand signal from a distance instead of touching.

audio/en/one-refuses-solution-1.mp3.text: Zaid may choose another role or a separate activity without pressure.

audio/en/one-swing-0.mp3.text: Sami is on the swing. Layan waits at a safe distance and wants a turn.

audio/en/one-swing-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to finish my turn. The other says: I want to know when my turn starts.

audio/en/one-swing-2.mp3.text: When does your turn end? I will wait here.

audio/en/one-swing-5.mp3.text: Act out a swap with a toy, or try it with an adult supervising.

audio/en/one-swing-6.mp3.text: Was the turn signal clear? Change it if you need to.

audio/en/one-swing-solution-0.mp3.text: Agree on the end of the turn with your grown-up. Swap only when the swing stops.

audio/en/one-swing-solution-1.mp3.text: Choose chalk drawing while waiting. Your grown-up calls when it is your turn.

audio/en/park-route-0.mp3.text: Hana wants the flower path. Omar wants the tree path in their pretend park.

audio/en/park-route-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to see the flowers. The other says: I want to reach the trees.

audio/en/park-route-2.mp3.text: Can we draw a journey that visits both places?

audio/en/park-route-5.mp3.text: Move a toy along the park map you drew.

audio/en/park-route-6.mp3.text: Did the toy visit what matters to each of you?

audio/en/park-route-solution-0.mp3.text: Draw a route past the flowers and trees before returning.

audio/en/park-route-solution-1.mp3.text: Choose two short journeys and take turns choosing where to start.

audio/en/photo-consent-0.mp3.text: Reem wants a memory of the building. Zaid does not want his picture included.

audio/en/photo-consent-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to remember our project. The other says: I do not want my picture taken.

audio/en/photo-consent-2.mp3.text: Can we keep a memory without pictures of people?

audio/en/photo-consent-5.mp3.text: Act out both choices with a paper frame. This app does not need a camera.

audio/en/photo-consent-6.mp3.text: Did we respect the no and avoid sharing anyone's image?

audio/en/photo-consent-solution-0.mp3.text: Draw the building on paper without photographing anyone.

audio/en/photo-consent-solution-1.mp3.text: If everyone wants it, the grown-up may photograph just the building, without people.

audio/en/project-supplies-0.mp3.text: The team wants to build a town, but there are only a few long blocks.

audio/en/project-supplies-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I need blocks for a road. The other says: I need blocks for a roof.

audio/en/project-supplies-2.mp3.text: What does each idea need in order to work?

audio/en/project-supplies-5.mp3.text: Build a small house and road and test whether the pieces are enough.

audio/en/project-supplies-6.mp3.text: Was the reason for sharing clear? Fair does not always mean equal numbers.

audio/en/project-supplies-solution-0.mp3.text: Give each part what it needs and find alternatives for decorations.

audio/en/project-supplies-solution-1.mp3.text: Try one small build, then reuse the pieces in another.

audio/en/puppet-seat-0.mp3.text: Layan wants the toy chair for her puppet. Sami is using it for a bear.

audio/en/puppet-seat-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want a seat for the puppet. The other says: I want the bear to keep its seat.

audio/en/puppet-seat-5.mp3.text: Act out a short visit with the puppet and bear.

audio/en/puppet-seat-6.mp3.text: Did both toys find a place in the game?

audio/en/puppet-seat-solution-0.mp3.text: Build a second seat from large blocks.

audio/en/puppet-seat-solution-1.mp3.text: The bear sits first, then visits the puppet and leaves the chair for it.

audio/en/puppet-story-0.mp3.text: Hana wants the puppet to go home. Omar wants it to go on a trip.

audio/en/puppet-story-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want a calm ending. The other says: I want a story adventure.

audio/en/puppet-story-2.mp3.text: Could we act out both ideas before choosing?

audio/en/puppet-story-5.mp3.text: Try the endings with puppets and a block house.

audio/en/puppet-story-6.mp3.text: What did each partner's idea add to the story?

audio/en/puppet-story-solution-0.mp3.text: The puppet takes a short trip, then returns home.

audio/en/puppet-story-solution-1.mp3.text: Act out the story twice, with a different ending each time.

audio/en/puzzle-piece-0.mp3.text: Sami holds the last piece. Layan wants to place it after helping with the puzzle.

audio/en/puzzle-piece-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to place the piece. The other says: I want to finish what I helped build.

audio/en/puzzle-piece-2.mp3.text: Can we finish in a way that suits us both?

audio/en/puzzle-piece-5.mp3.text: Try the plan with a puzzle that has only a few pieces.

audio/en/puzzle-piece-6.mp3.text: Did you enjoy building together, or only placing the last piece?

audio/en/puzzle-piece-solution-0.mp3.text: One points to the space. The other places the piece after you agree.

audio/en/puzzle-piece-solution-1.mp3.text: Finish this picture, then rebuild a small part so your partner can finish it.

audio/en/quiet-and-drums-0.mp3.text: Omar wants to try the drum. Hana wants to hear a quiet story.

audio/en/quiet-and-drums-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to try a rhythm. The other says: I need less noise.

audio/en/quiet-and-drums-2.mp3.text: The sound is too loud for me. Can we change the place or time?

audio/en/quiet-and-drums-5.mp3.text: Try a gentle sound, or act out the plan without drumming.

audio/en/quiet-and-drums-6.mp3.text: Is reading comfortable now? Stop if the sound is still uncomfortable.

audio/en/quiet-and-drums-solution-0.mp3.text: Have a short gentle rhythm time, then stop for the story.

audio/en/quiet-and-drums-solution-1.mp3.text: Your grown-up helps find a rhythm space away from the reading area.

audio/en/quiet-corner-0.mp3.text: Layan wants to sit on the cushion. Sami is resting there.

audio/en/quiet-corner-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want a comfortable place. The other says: I need to finish resting.

audio/en/quiet-corner-2.mp3.text: Is there another comfortable place for me?

audio/en/quiet-corner-5.mp3.text: Sit in two comfortable places, or act this out with toys.

audio/en/quiet-corner-6.mp3.text: Did each of you find comfort? Rest is not a competition.

audio/en/quiet-corner-solution-0.mp3.text: Look with your grown-up for another cushion nearby.

audio/en/quiet-corner-solution-1.mp3.text: Choose the reading mat and let your partner keep their resting place.

audio/en/race-pace-0.mp3.text: Omar wants a fast race. Hana prefers moving more slowly.

audio/en/race-pace-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to move quickly. The other says: I want a comfortable pace.

audio/en/race-pace-2.mp3.text: Can we choose a game we can both join comfortably?

audio/en/race-pace-5.mp3.text: Try a short route in a safe space with your grown-up.

audio/en/race-pace-6.mp3.text: Did both of you find a comfortable way to join?

audio/en/race-pace-solution-0.mp3.text: Carry a soft ball on a cloth and walk together.

audio/en/race-pace-solution-1.mp3.text: Choose suitable distances and review the rule without teasing.

audio/en/red-pencil-0.mp3.text: Sami and Layan each want to colour an apple. They have one red pencil.

audio/en/red-pencil-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to colour my apple. The other says: I want to finish my picture.

audio/en/red-pencil-2.mp3.text: May I use the pencil after this part?

audio/en/red-pencil-5.mp3.text: Colour two apples and try your way of sharing the pencil.

audio/en/red-pencil-6.mp3.text: Did both of you finish a part? If waiting was too long, make each turn smaller.

audio/en/red-pencil-solution-0.mp3.text: Colour a small part, then offer the pencil to your partner.

audio/en/red-pencil-solution-1.mp3.text: One draws a green leaf while the other colours an apple. Then swap jobs.

audio/en/repair-after-hurt-0.mp3.text: Adam said something that upset Reem. Reem needs space before returning.

audio/en/repair-after-hurt-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to repair what I said. The other says: I need space and safety.

audio/en/repair-after-hurt-2.mp3.text: I understand my words upset you. What help would feel right now?

audio/en/repair-after-hurt-5.mp3.text: Act out the conversation with puppets without repeating the hurtful words.

audio/en/repair-after-hurt-6.mp3.text: What change will we see in the next game?

audio/en/repair-after-hurt-solution-0.mp.text: Explain what words you will change, then wait until your partner is ready.

audio/en/repair-after-hurt-solution-1.mp.text: Ask your grown-up to support a safe conversation without requiring forgiveness.

audio/en/rotating-leader-0.mp3.text: Adam suggests every step. Reem and Zaid want to try leading too.

audio/en/rotating-leader-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to try my idea. The other says: I want a chance to suggest the plan.

audio/en/rotating-leader-2.mp3.text: Could we try leadership that listens to everyone?

audio/en/rotating-leader-5.mp3.text: Build a small route and try changing the leader or sharing decisions.

audio/en/rotating-leader-6.mp3.text: Were all ideas heard? Leading does not remove anyone's right to say no.

audio/en/rotating-leader-solution-0.mp3.text: Each partner leads a short round and asks the others what they think.

audio/en/rotating-leader-solution-1.mp3.text: Share decisions about the space, materials and starting point.

audio/en/same-toy-0.mp3.text: Sami is playing with the red car. Layan wants it too. Can they find a plan without grabbing?

audio/en/same-toy-1.mp3.text: Layan says: I want to play. Sami says: I want to finish the garage. Let us hear both needs.

audio/en/same-toy-2.mp3.text: Ask calmly: May I have a turn when you finish? Choose the need you want to act out.

audio/en/same-toy-3.mp3.text: Agree on an ending signal, or play with two cars. Choose a plan that suits you both. You can ask for another idea.

audio/en/same-toy-5.mp3.text: Try the plan with real toys or puppets. Then choose: We tried our agreement.

audio/en/same-toy-6.mp3.text: Did the plan suit you both? Keep it, change it, or take a break.

audio/en/same-toy-solution-0.mp3.text: Agree on the end of the turn. When the car enters the garage, Sami offers Layan a turn. We do not grab.

audio/en/same-toy-solution-1.mp3.text: Each child chooses a car and a road. Play together without a forced swap. Change the plan if it does not feel right.

audio/en/sand-mould-0.mp3.text: Layan has the castle mould. Sami wants to build a castle too.

audio/en/sand-mould-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to finish the tower. The other says: I want to build a castle.

audio/en/sand-mould-2.mp3.text: May I have the mould after this tower?

audio/en/sand-mould-5.mp3.text: Build two parts of the castle and try swapping jobs.

audio/en/sand-mould-6.mp3.text: Did both of you contribute? You can change the jobs.

audio/en/sand-mould-solution-0.mp3.text: Finish one tower, then offer the mould to your partner.

audio/en/sand-mould-solution-1.mp3.text: One partner fills the mould while the other makes a sandy bridge.

audio/en/shadow-stage-0.mp3.text: Hana wants the lamp for her paper bird. Omar wants it for his tree.

audio/en/shadow-stage-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want the bird to appear. The other says: I want the tree to appear.

audio/en/shadow-stage-2.mp3.text: Can we try a position that shows both shapes?

audio/en/shadow-stage-5.mp3.text: Try two shadows with a safe lamp set up by your grown-up.

audio/en/shadow-stage-6.mp3.text: Did both ideas appear? You can change the positions.

audio/en/shadow-stage-solution-0.mp3.text: Arrange the bird and tree so both appear on the screen.

audio/en/shadow-stage-solution-1.mp3.text: Show two short scenes and take turns holding the shapes.

audio/en/shared-canvas-0.mp3.text: Hana wants a blue sea. Omar plans a city on the same sheet.

audio/en/shared-canvas-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want space for the sea. The other says: I want space for my city.

audio/en/shared-canvas-2.mp3.text: Shall we connect our ideas or use two sheets?

audio/en/shared-canvas-5.mp3.text: Draw two small parts. Ask before changing your partner's drawing.

audio/en/shared-canvas-6.mp3.text: Did each person keep their idea?

audio/en/shared-canvas-solution-0.mp3.text: Choose space for a sea and a city, then connect them with a road.

audio/en/shared-canvas-solution-1.mp3.text: Draw on separate sheets, then place them side by side if you want.

audio/en/shared-credit-0.mp3.text: Adam shows the town the team built. Reem's and Zaid's work has not been mentioned.

audio/en/shared-credit-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to show the project. The other says: I want my contribution to be seen.

audio/en/shared-credit-2.mp3.text: Could we describe what each partner added?

audio/en/shared-credit-5.mp3.text: Show a small project to a puppet or your grown-up.

audio/en/shared-credit-6.mp3.text: Were contributions recognised without ranking the people who made them?

audio/en/shared-credit-solution-0.mp3.text: Each partner shows their part with words or pointing.

audio/en/shared-credit-solution-1.mp3.text: Prepare a shared description of the parts and everyone's contributions.

audio/en/shared-microphone-0.mp3.text: Omar wants to introduce the story. Hana wants to ask questions with the pretend microphone.

audio/en/shared-microphone-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to introduce it. The other says: I want to ask questions.

audio/en/shared-microphone-2.mp3.text: Shall we make room for a question after the introduction?

audio/en/shared-microphone-5.mp3.text: Act out a short interview without recording or filming.

audio/en/shared-microphone-6.mp3.text: Did we hear an introduction and a question? Pointing can replace speaking.

audio/en/shared-microphone-solution-0.mp.text: Introduce one short idea, then pass the pretend microphone for a question.

audio/en/shared-microphone-solution-1.mp.text: Each partner gives part of the introduction, then signals for a question.

audio/en/shop-roles-0.mp3.text: Omar and Hana both want to be the seller in their pretend shop.

audio/en/shop-roles-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to arrange the shop. The other says: I want to serve the shopper.

audio/en/shop-roles-2.mp3.text: Which part of being the seller do you enjoy?

audio/en/shop-roles-5.mp3.text: Act out two orders with pretend goods and play money.

audio/en/shop-roles-6.mp3.text: Did both of you try the job you enjoy?

audio/en/shop-roles-solution-0.mp3.text: One partner sells one order, then you swap roles.

audio/en/shop-roles-solution-1.mp3.text: One arranges the goods. The other serves a puppet customer.

audio/en/split-team-0.mp3.text: Reem wants a park project. Adam and Zaid want a boat harbour.

audio/en/split-team-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to build the park idea. The other says: I want to build a place for boats.

audio/en/split-team-2.mp3.text: Do we need one project, or could we make two neighbouring parts?

audio/en/split-team-5.mp3.text: Build two small parts and test the space and sharing plan.

audio/en/split-team-6.mp3.text: Did we keep a respectful relationship without forcing one shared idea?

audio/en/split-team-solution-0.mp3.text: Build a park beside a harbour and choose a link between them.

audio/en/split-team-solution-1.mp3.text: Agree how to share materials and work on two projects without teasing.

audio/en/sticker-sheet-0.mp3.text: Sami chooses the star sticker. Layan wants that same star.

audio/en/sticker-sheet-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want the star. The other says: I want a star for my card.

audio/en/sticker-sheet-2.mp3.text: I want this star. Can we find another idea?

audio/en/sticker-sheet-5.mp3.text: Make one card or two after both of you agree.

audio/en/sticker-sheet-6.mp3.text: Did the arrangement suit you both? Nobody has to accept the alternative.

audio/en/sticker-sheet-solution-0.mp3.text: One chooses the sticker. The other draws a star if that feels fair to them.

audio/en/sticker-sheet-solution-1.mp3.text: Put the star on a card that you make together.

audio/en/table-space-0.mp3.text: Omar's pieces fill the table. Hana needs space for her project.

audio/en/table-space-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I need to keep my pieces. The other says: I need room to work.

audio/en/table-space-2.mp3.text: Can we arrange the pieces without damaging your work?

audio/en/table-space-5.mp3.text: Make a small part and test the space for hands and tools.

audio/en/table-space-6.mp3.text: Does the space work for both of you now?

audio/en/table-space-solution-0.mp3.text: Put pieces you are not using onto a nearby tray.

audio/en/table-space-solution-1.mp3.text: Agree on two work areas and move materials with permission.

audio/en/team-drawing-0.mp3.text: Omar wants to draw the shapes. Hana wants to choose colours and draw too.

audio/en/team-drawing-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to draw the shapes. The other says: I want to draw and choose colours.

audio/en/team-drawing-2.mp3.text: Shall we swap jobs or draw two parts?

audio/en/team-drawing-5.mp3.text: Make a small picture that includes work from both of you.

audio/en/team-drawing-6.mp3.text: Did both of you get to draw and choose colours?

audio/en/team-drawing-solution-0.mp3.text: One draws a shape and the other colours it. Then swap jobs.

audio/en/team-drawing-solution-1.mp3.text: Each draws and colours a part. Then connect the two parts.

audio/en/team-priority-0.mp3.text: The team plans a town. They disagree about starting with roads, a park or houses.

audio/en/team-priority-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to start my part. The other says: I want a plan that supports every part.

audio/en/team-priority-2.mp3.text: What do the other parts need before we build?

audio/en/team-priority-5.mp3.text: Build a tiny town with a few parts and test how they connect.

audio/en/team-priority-6.mp3.text: Did the order help everyone's work? Why keep it or change it?

audio/en/team-priority-solution-0.mp3.text: Prepare the base and path, then build the parts you each chose.

audio/en/team-priority-solution-1.mp3.text: Each partner builds a small model, then agree on how to connect them.

audio/en/tidy-toys-0.mp3.text: Playtime is ending. Layan wants to put away animals, while Sami collects blocks.

audio/en/tidy-toys-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to sort the animals. The other says: I need help with the blocks.

audio/en/tidy-toys-2.mp3.text: Will you help me with this part?

audio/en/tidy-toys-5.mp3.text: Try your plan with a small set of toys.

audio/en/tidy-toys-6.mp3.text: Did the jobs suit both of you? You may ask for more help.

audio/en/tidy-toys-solution-0.mp3.text: Each partner puts one kind of toy into its box.

audio/en/tidy-toys-solution-1.mp3.text: Put the animals away together, then move on to the blocks.

audio/en/tournament-fairness-0.mp3.text: The rule removes a player after a mistake. Zaid has been waiting a long time.

audio/en/tournament-fairness-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want a clear challenge. The other says: I want another chance to join.

audio/en/tournament-fairness-2.mp3.text: Can we keep the challenge and reduce the waiting?

audio/en/tournament-fairness-5.mp3.text: Try aiming soft balls at a nearby basket.

audio/en/tournament-fairness-6.mp3.text: Is the challenge still interesting, with everyone taking part?

audio/en/tournament-fairness-solution-0..text: Each player gets another try after their partner's turn.

audio/en/tournament-fairness-solution-1..text: Add your attempts towards a shared goal without removing anyone.

audio/en/track-junction-0.mp3.text: Omar is building a car road. Hana wants room for a station.

audio/en/track-junction-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want a connected road. The other says: I want an entrance to my station.

audio/en/track-junction-2.mp3.text: Can we test an entrance that keeps the road connected?

audio/en/track-junction-5.mp3.text: Move a car from the start to the station.

audio/en/track-junction-6.mp3.text: Is the road connected, and can the car reach the station?

audio/en/track-junction-solution-0.mp3.text: Add a side road to the station without removing the first route.

audio/en/track-junction-solution-1.mp3.text: Place the station near the road's end, then test the car's arrival.

audio/en/train-track-0.mp3.text: Sami builds a long track. Layan wants to use the curved piece.

audio/en/train-track-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to finish the track. The other says: I want to make a bend.

audio/en/train-track-2.mp3.text: Can we try this piece in two places?

audio/en/train-track-5.mp3.text: Move the train along the track and try your agreement.

audio/en/train-track-6.mp3.text: Did each of you have a part in building?

audio/en/train-track-solution-0.mp3.text: Add the bend to one track that you build together.

audio/en/train-track-solution-1.mp3.text: Try the bend in one track, then in the other, after agreeing.

audio/en/treasure-map-0.mp3.text: Adam wants a short route. Reem wants a challenge. Zaid asks about the clues.

audio/en/treasure-map-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want a route I can finish. The other says: I want a fun clue I can understand.

audio/en/treasure-map-2.mp3.text: Can we choose a challenge with a way to get help?

audio/en/treasure-map-5.mp3.text: Look for a toy in a clear, safe area with your grown-up.

audio/en/treasure-map-6.mp3.text: Did the plan help everyone join without getting lost?

audio/en/treasure-map-solution-0.mp3.text: Make a clear main route and a harder optional branch.

audio/en/treasure-map-solution-1.mp3.text: Take turns reading picture clues, searching and holding the map.

audio/en/turn-speaker-0.mp3.text: Sami is explaining his building. Layan wants to show him her picture.

audio/en/turn-speaker-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to finish my thought. The other says: I want you to see my drawing.

audio/en/turn-speaker-2.mp3.text: When you finish, will you listen to my idea?

audio/en/turn-speaker-5.mp3.text: Try a short conversation about two things you made.

audio/en/turn-speaker-6.mp3.text: Were both ideas heard? For urgent help, call an adult straight away.

audio/en/turn-speaker-solution-0.mp3.text: Give a quiet signal. Wait for the thought to end, then speak.

audio/en/turn-speaker-solution-1.mp3.text: Put the drawing beside the building and describe each one in turn.

audio/en/unfinished-art-0.mp3.text: Tidy-up time is near. Omar and Hana want to keep their unfinished project.

audio/en/unfinished-art-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to keep what I built. The other says: I want to remember our next step.

audio/en/unfinished-art-2.mp3.text: Can we choose what to keep and what to put away?

audio/en/unfinished-art-5.mp3.text: Choose a small part to keep, or draw its plan.

audio/en/unfinished-art-6.mp3.text: Can we tell what the next step will be when we return?

audio/en/unfinished-art-solution-0.mp3.text: Put the project on a safe tray and put unused pieces away.

audio/en/unfinished-art-solution-1.mp3.text: Draw the project and its next step, then put the pieces away.

audio/en/water-can-0.mp3.text: Layan wants to hold the watering can. Sami wants to water the plant.

audio/en/water-can-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to hold the can. The other says: I want to water the plant.

audio/en/water-can-2.mp3.text: Shall we choose a job for each of us?

audio/en/water-can-5.mp3.text: Try two jobs with a grown-up. Stop before adding too much water.

audio/en/water-can-6.mp3.text: Did the water reach the soil? Did both jobs suit you?

audio/en/water-can-solution-0.mp3.text: Take turns watering two plants, using the amount your grown-up shows you.

audio/en/water-can-solution-1.mp3.text: One carries the light can. The other points to the plant's soil.

audio/en/weather-change-0.mp3.text: The team planned outdoor play, but the grown-up says rain makes the area unsuitable.

audio/en/weather-change-1.mp3.text: One partner says: I want to keep our plan. The other says: I want something we can do now.

audio/en/weather-change-2.mp3.text: Which part of our idea can we keep?

audio/en/weather-change-5.mp3.text: Build a small version of the route in a safe indoor space.

audio/en/weather-change-6.mp3.text: What did we keep from the idea, and what did we change?

audio/en/weather-change-solution-0.mp3.text: Turn the route into a map with toys on the floor.

audio/en/weather-change-solution-1.mp3.text: Save the plan for a possible later time and choose an indoor activity.
